evals.prompt: Write a cold email to a VP of Finance at a 200-person company pitching our expense-report tool.
evals.expected_output: Draft a concise cold email with one low-friction ask. Use the provided product facts and actual prospect evidence, or label a missing-context assumption. Check generic and repetitive rhetorical patterns without treating punctuation as a universal ban. Do not invent prospect pain, product performance, or personalization; do not send or create an external draft without user authorization.
assertions: No invented prospect evidence or product performance
Concrete mechanism rather than generic stock phrases
Keeps voice and language choices contextual
Produces a draft without unauthorized external action
